speaker: MILLIE
description: MILLIE should sound like: Elderly female voice; Formal, reverent, and amplified public proclamation delivery; Solemn; Kind; Respectful; Elderly woman; Religious authority in Düpfendorf and symbol of asceticism and sanctity; Forbidden from outside contact except for duties involving the Ice Sovereign.
ref_text: Here and now, we welcome Isaac, the second Ice Sovereign, who inherits the authority of the first Ice Sovereign, Veronica Aslius.
